description: Escort: Fleet Convoy: radio lead-in, calls and sign-offs.

briefing: Six haulers and a frigate for cover. {enemy} will bring everything they have. Keep the line together.
Big convoy leaving {system}. {client} cannot afford to lose it.
Fleet convoy, escort duty. The frigate is yours to work with.
success: Convoy through. {client} will remember who flew with it.
Gate reached with the line intact. Well done, {captain}.
The raiders are spent and the freight is safe.
failure: The convoy is scattered. {client} counts what is left.
Escort failed. The lane belongs to {enemy} for now.
radio-convoy: Six haulers formed. Gate bearing ahead.
radio-guard: Frigate and two gunships holding with the convoy.
Escort frigate on station. Use it.
Our frigate is with the line.
radio-raiders: Raiders ahead, eight ships. Two are gunships.
radio-wings: More on the left. They want the haulers.
radio-ship: Enemy frigate, far side, with escorts.
They have a warship. Keep clear of its guns.
Frigate contact. Do not let it near the line.
